integrity: The proof and exact finite verification are included; examples are not proofs for arbitrary graph size.
scientific_limitations: Only a virtual rational character identity and ordinary quotient Euler identity; no statement of graded module equality or equivariant homotopy equivalence. Assumes finite simple graph with no isolated vertices. Novelty subject to unindexed prior work.
title: An equivariant sinkless-orientation identity for graph flex complexes
